resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (open-source plane-wave DFT code)

access.notes: Any recent version; standard plane-wave DFT. The agent may choose another open-source plane-wave DFT code (e.g., VASP, ABINIT) if it can produce equivalent quantities, but Quantum ESPRESSO is recommended.

resources.notes: Used as the open-source equivalent of CASTEP to run the MD simulation.

resources.name: GGA-PBE ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Li, Pb, H

access.notes: Standard pseudopotentials from the QE pseudo archive or SSSP library. The specific choice may slightly affect absolute populations, but the negative correlation and vibrational frequency range are robust.

resources.notes: Ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Li.pbe-...UPF, Pb.pbe-...UPF, H.pbe-...UPF. The agent must select a consistent set.
